title: Pixel Pawns: chess where every capture is an animated duel (23-second trailer)
text:
Pixel Pawns is our pixel-art chess for Windows PC: classic chess rules, but every capture turns into an animated duel between the two pieces. Here is the 23-second trailer: https://youtu.be/kg31aqvjqZw

Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP9G5CQKKZX
Website: https://pixelpawns.bugfactory.hu

title: The last of 17 duels: queen takes bishop, checkmate (one full AI vs AI chess match in Pixel Pawns)
text: We let the game's own AI play a full chess match against itself and kept every capture: 17 animated duels, ending with this one, queen takes bishop on d6, checkmate for Ivory. Every move is a legal move from the real game; both sides are the built-in AI. The full 17-duel cut is on our YouTube channel as a Short. Pixel Pawns is pixel-art chess where every capture is a duel, on Windows PC and Xbox. Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP9G5CQKKZX?cid=rd
